name: fluf-mcp
description: Work your FLUF Connect account from Claude: what's live where, dead stock, orders, failed listings, and crosslisting.
long_description:
FLUF Connect lists one item across Depop, eBay, Shopify, Etsy, Vinted, Facebook and more. This extension lets Claude work that account directly.

Ask in plain language — "what's in stock that isn't on eBay yet?", "what sold last week and where?", "why did my last five Vinted listings fail?" — or use a recipe for a whole workflow: /dead_stock, /morning_sales, /listing_failures, /expansion, /support.

Five of the six tools only read your account. Only `crosslist` writes, and it creates listings — nothing here can edit or delete one. Claude asks your approval before every action.

You need a FLUF Connect account on a paid plan and a token from More → Developers at https://fluf.io/connect/developers.

fluf_api_token.title: FLUF API token
fluf_api_token.description: Create one at https://fluf.io/connect/developers (More → Developers in the sidebar). It starts with fluf_pat_ and is shown only once.

fluf_base_url.title: FLUF address
fluf_base_url.description: Leave this alone unless FLUF support asks you to change it.

tools.name: list_channels
tools.description: Which marketplaces this account has connected, and which it can list to.

tools.name: list_products
tools.description: Your products, with the channels each one is already live on.

tools.name: get_orders
tools.description: Your orders across every connected marketplace, in one shape.

tools.name: ask_intesa
tools.description: Ask FLUF's own assistant an open-ended question about your account.

tools.name: crosslist
tools.description: List one or more products on one or more marketplaces.

tools.name: report_bug
tools.description: Raise a bug with FLUF support on your behalf.
